newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - July 14.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Shanghai listed firms began reporting their 1997 interim results with Shanghai Haixin Co being the first to post results.
- Shanghai's foreign trade turnover grew by a year-on-year 10 percent to $24.4 billion yuan in the first six months of this year.
- More than 300 new foreign-invested projects worth $2.7 billion were started in Pudong in the first six months of this year with the value up by a year-on-year 6.5 percent.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Property sales in Pudong increased by a year-on-year 55.8 percent in the first half of this year.

- Commentary says China's success in curbing inflation in the first half of this year may help the nation keep the retail price inflation rate between three to four percent for the whole of this year.
